Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, what the heck is that sound? Come on, Ferb, I know what we're not gonna do today

Name: Candace
Dialog: (slams open her window) If you don't stop that racket, I am so gonna bust you... empty... backyard? (The wailing stops.)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (closes window) Candace, stop trying to bust your backyard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (rushingly picks up her cell phone) Jeremy! Yes? Yes! We'll see you in a bit. Thanks. No, you get off the phone- (phone disconnects) Hello?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So, what's the scoop?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy just invited us to his friend's concert!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, I don't know... Lately I've been feeling like a third wheel around you guys.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, goody. The Chart.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, Jeremy only calls me "Candace," and nothing else. When a guy makes you his girlfriend, he comes up with a nickname for you. A pet name like, "baby," "honey," "Peg-Leg Pete!" His own personal stamp!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Maybe you should just let whatever happens happen. You know, naturally.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (scoffs) Naturally? (the wail starts again.) Where is that coming from?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet's house? For such a mild-mannered kid, we wind up here for a lot of weird reasons. (Ferb is shown with fingers in his ears.) Ah, I wish I had some earplugs. (Ferb holds up a dual earplug shaped like fingers.) Thanks dude! (cut to Baljeet's room, where he is holding a guitar and facing the wall.) So, uh... What up 'jeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, uh... Hello my friends, I did not hear you come in.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Is everything okay?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: If by okay, you mean that my life is a meaningless, black cauldron of swirling failure... then yes, everything is groovy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's not at all what I meant by "okay."

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I signed up for a class called "Summer Rocks," believing it was a geology course. It turned out to be a rock-and-roll camp, and no matter how hard I study, I just do not rock! I could actually get an e- (tries to say "F") an- Oh, I can't even say that terrible letter. Ineas! Erb! What am I going to do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that was an interesting sound you were getting out of your guitar. I think you'll be just fine!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That was not my guitar. That was me. I call it "The Fail Wail." (begins wailing again)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet. Baljeet! Whoa! Hey! (Baljeet stops wailing.) Thank you. We can show you how to rock!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Absolutely. Hey, I think the Fail Wail scared Perry off!

Name: Usher
Dialog: Ticket, please. (Perry hands him a ticket) Right this way! (guides Perry to his chair) Enjoy the show.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Evil... wait... You... await... Evil... awaits...

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) Cut, cut!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, come on! (to Perry) Sorry, Agent P. Carl's been taking some film classes and now believes I'm stifling his creativity as my cameraman.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (pats Monogram with a makeup sponge) Camera artist.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Seems Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been buying baby supplies all over town. One could only imagine what he's doing. Two can discuss it between themselves; more than two is frankly a waste of our resources. Good luck, Agent P! (Perry leaves)

Name: Carl
Dialog: Okay, once more with feeling!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The agency isn't paying for these classes, are they Carl?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I have read every book on the history of rock music.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Gosh, Baljeet, rock and roll isn't about books! It's about letting go and having fun! Rock and roll is a way for you to tell the world how you feel!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Feel about what?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Expressing yourself! I mean, what do you do when you're angry?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Math.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...Okay, what about when you're sad?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Math!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Happy?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ma-ath!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So every feeling you have makes you want to do math?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not know if it is so much cause and effect. I do a lot of math! The feelings come and go.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What kind of concert is this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's the "Summer Rocks" graduation concert. Jeremy's friend Coltrane is an instructor. (spots Jeremy and Coltrane talking) Look, there they are!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, That's Coltrane. He's really cute!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm, I guess he is. Hey, wait a minute... You like Coltrane!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, I've never actually talked to him before, but...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Quick, what should we do? Hide? No, wait, pretend you're a talent scout. Ooh, here! I think I have a fake mustache on me!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Let's just go over and say hi. (leads Candace over to the two boys, who are talking)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (to Coltrane) What do you think it means when a girl leaves a fake mustache at your house?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking up with Stacy) Hi guys!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey gals!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! "Gals." Yeah, that's me, "the gal." Gosh, when did you start calling me that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (to Coltrane) Hi, I'm Stacy.

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Hey, how ya doin', Stacy? I'm Coltrane.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I like your hair.

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Thanks. I like your bow. Let me show you round.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Cool! (the two of them leave)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Heeey, Coltrane and Stacyyyy... that was easy. (Candace glares at him) What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Awww, congratulations, it's a platypus! (laughs) What do you think of my new Nanny-inator? Nice, huh? (pushes a rocking chair up to the playpen) You know what time it is? Evil story time! (sits down) See, I wrote my new evil scheme (holds up a book titled "My Evil Plan") in pop-up book format. Once upon a time, yesterday, like a quarter to six, (opens book to page of Doofenshmirtz sitting in front of a TV) I was watching a nature documentary, and I learned how before a baby's born, its constant companion is the soothing, steady beat of its mother's heart. Even after it's born, the sound of the mother's heartbeat (turns page to a happy mother holding a baby) continues to be a safe, calming beacon to a growing child, (turns page to an annoyed mother holding a grown man) in some cases up until their early thirties. Suddenly, I was struck with a brilliant idea

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Rock's not about getting good grades and following the rules; it's about rebellion! It's about using music to express your true feelings and emotions! Just play how you feel! (Baljeet plays a single chord) Baljeet, that's- that's just an A chord.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I feel like I want an A!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is gonna be harder than we thought.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Do you think you could teach me how to play the bass?

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Let's see if you have big bass player hands. (they hold up hands to compare sizes)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from a bush, trying to imitate a bird) Bu-GA! Bu-GA! Ooka-ooka-ooka-ooka!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, excuse me for a second. (Candace repeats her "bird call") I have to go talk to my friend in the bushes.

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Cool! I gotta go get this show started. Save me a dance?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (still in the bush, still making her "bird call") Koo-koo-koo-koo-kooooo! Ki-KA! Ki-KA! (Stacy walks up to her) Ooka-ooka-ooka-ooka! Eega-eega-eega!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What are you doin'?

Name: Candace
Dialog: How's it going with you and Coltrane?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think it's going really well! He asked me to save him a dance!

Name: Candace
Dialog: He did? What do you think he meant by that?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'm pretty sure he meant he wants to dance with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmmm. Men and their impossible endless riddles!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So how's it going with you? Has Jeremy nicknamed you yet?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Maybe Jeremy just isn't the kind of guy who nicknames people.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh. You could be right.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look, here he comes now!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (greeting people as he passes them) Yo, T-Bone! Hey, Clammo! What up, Sassy Miss K? Momo! Binkie... (reaches Stacy and Candace) Hi Candace, where you been?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'll, uh... I'll see you later.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Catch ya later, Staceroo. (Candace glares at him again) What?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ohhhh, I do not know about this!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You'll be great! Just remember what we practiced

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am about to let my feelings out through these pleather pants!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I'm almost ready, Perry the Platypus. (pointing to a heart monitor on his wrist) This monitor takes my pulse and transmits it to the Bum-Bum-inator, which will then broadcast my heartbeat to all the babies in the Tri-State Area. See? (the Bum-Bum-inator begins beating.) You might say I'm wearing my sleeve on my... I- I mean my heart is wearing, uh... Never mind, whatever, you get it! Ah-ha-HA-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!! (raises the Bum-Bum-inator through the roof, broadcasting the heartbeat)

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: And now, the band you've all been waiting for

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (hears the heartbeat and mistakes it for a drumbeat) Hey, cool beat, Buford.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh... thanks? (Begins mimicking the beat; Phineas and Ferb start playing as well. Baljeet peeks around the curtain from backstage.)

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: What's up, Baljeet? Your band is waiting for you onstage.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I can't do it! I just do not know how to rock! (emotionally) I know I am going to get a bad grade!

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: Wait, what are you talking about, "grades"? This is Summer Rocks! There are no grades.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No grades? Oh, so it is pass/fail?

Name: Coltrane
Dialog: No! We use a free-floating curriculum to encourage kids to just... rock out and have fun!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (outraged) I do not believe this! I wasted all this time in a class without grades?!? Aohhhhh! If only there were some other kind of outlet for me to express these feelings to my like-minded peer group! (comes to a realization. peeks at the stage than to Coltrane.) Pardon me! I want to try something! (Runs and stomps onto stage. Their song "Gimme a Grade" plays. As they continue with the song, the audience sway and move their heads along with the beat.)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh yeah! I have got something to say!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, now to relax and keep my heart rate slow and steady, you know, 'cause too much excitement would cause my heart to beat too fast and short out the Bum-Bum-inator.

Name: Nanny-inator
Dialog: Change time! Change time! (Perry jumps on the Nanny-inator's arm when it reaches for him, climbs out of the cage while the Nanny-inator accidentally breaks itself, and tackles Doofenshmirtz, who grunts while his heart rate rises, which makes the Bum-Bum inator beat faster, causing the music to speed up as well. Perry chases Doofenshmirtz around the room.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, stop chasing me; I'm supposed to keep my heart rate down!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, I am so upset!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Somebody gimme a grade!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh oh. Not good. (the Bum-Bum-inator shorts out and flies across the sky, yanking Doofenshmirtz along with it)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (continues) CURSE YOU, PERRY THE- (passes over the Summer Rocks stage) Wait, is that the Baljeatles?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just call me "Can't-Dance Flynn."

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (laughs) Okay, that's your new nickname.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what? No! I'm not supposed to nickname myself! You're supposed to come up with it! (starts crying) You don't even care enough to try!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, wait a second! I call you Candace, but not because I don't care enough to come up with a cute nickname for you! I call you Candace 'cause... I happen to really like that name.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You do?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Of course I do! 'Cause it's your name. (they hug)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (standing next to Coltrane) That was easy. (they look down and see that they're holding hands, then smile at each other)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Baljeet, if it means anything, I'd give you an A+ in rock.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No. That means almost nothing.
